name: Bingles' Missing Supplies
summary: Bingles Blastenheimer is stranded on Loch Modan's southeastern shore after troggs steal his gear. He needs his tools and Blastencapper explosives to repair his gyrocopter and return to the fight for Gnomeregan.

sections.title: A Damp Descent
sections.body: Bingles Blastenheimer crashes his gyrocopter into Loch Modan's cold waters. He survives and drags himself ashore, but troggs from the lake's central islands swarm the dazed pilot and steal his most valuable belongings.

sections.title: Gnomish Ingenuity Under Siege
sections.body: Troggs scatter Bingles' gear among their island camps. His missing supplies include a wrench, screwdriver, and hammer, along with the Blastenheimer Blastencapper, his volatile, high-yield invention. Losing ordinary tools is troublesome; leaving explosives in a region crawling with troggs puts travelers in immediate danger.

sections.title: For Gnomeregan
sections.body: Bingles fights for the liberation of his fallen homeland, Gnomeregan. It is overrun by subterranean troggs and irradiated leper gnomes, and he imagines a decisive aerial assault to break their hold. Without his tools and Blastencappers, he cannot rebuild his flying machine, and his campaign remains grounded in the reeds.

faq.q: Why is Bingles Blastenheimer stranded in Loch Modan?
faq.answer: Bingles crashed his gyrocopter into Loch Modan. As he struggled ashore on the southeastern bank, troggs from nearby islands ambushed him and stole his tools and experimental explosives.

faq.q: What supplies were stolen by the troggs?
faq.answer: The troggs stole Bingles' wrench, screwdriver, hammer, and specialized explosive, the Blastenheimer Blastencapper.

faq.q: Where did the troggs take Bingles' gear?
faq.answer: The troggs took Bingles' gear to their camps on islands in the northern part of the Loch, scattering the tools and explosives along the rocky shores.
The Blastenheimer Blastencapper is an explosive device Bingles designed for air strikes against the enemies occupying Gnomeregan.

faq.q: What movement is Bingles referring to?
faq.answer: Bingles is committed to reclaiming Gnomeregan. He hopes to lead an aerial bombardment against the subterranean troggs and leper gnomes holding the gnomish capital.

faq.q: Why can't Bingles retrieve the supplies himself?
faq.answer: Bingles is alone and unarmed after surviving the crash, with his gyrocopter out of reach. Crossing open water to face aggressive troggs without weapons or aircraft would be suicide for a lone engineer.

angles.text: As a gnome, each tool you recover brings your people closer to an aerial counteroffensive against the troggs and leper gnomes suffocating Gnomeregan.
As a dwarf, you know the troggs on the Loch's islands threaten local trade and travel. Any blow against their camps helps the Mountaineers.
As an engineer, you know specialized tools and volatile explosives like the Blastenheimer Blastencapper are dangerous in trogg hands and an affront to craftsmanship.
As an Alliance member, helping a fellow pilot in Loch Modan secures the waterways and aids the wider effort to reclaim Khaz Modan's lost territories.
